items.title: Reddit Sinks 34% in a Week on a Weak Outlook: “AI Mode Does Not Drive Traffic”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysReddit shares fell 34% in a week on weak fourth-quarter guidance and a warning that daily users could fall by a low-double-digit percentage. CEO Steve Huffman blames AI Mode on Alphabet’s Google, which keeps more searchers on Google itself.

items.title: Snap Sinks 14% in a Week on Social Ad Fears, Then Settles Its Teen Addiction Trial
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSnap shares fell 14% in a week as weak ad results and outlooks from Alphabet, Reddit and Pinterest hit social stocks, and Meta’s settlement left Snap alone in a teen addiction trial. Snap settled with the two teenage plaintiffs on Monday, taking the nearest legal risk off the table.
